Claim 1 (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the station includes a timer that measures elapsed time since the alarm condition was triggered, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged before expiration of the timer, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track acknowledgement status of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an acknowledgement status indicating whether the alarm has been acknowledged; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm based on whether the alarm has been acknowledged within a predetermined time period.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, including a timestamp of when the alarm was acknowledged.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices only when the alarm has not been acknowledged within a predetermined time period.
